header.menu: Open or close the sidebar (chats and projects)
header.settings: Opens the main settings panel: AI engines, local URLs, visual themes and global model parameters
input.attach: Upload files (PDF, Markdown, code) or images. Their content is extracted locally and injected as context for the AI in this specific message.
input.prompts: Saved prompt library. You can also type / in the chat.
input.send: Sends the whole chat history + serialized documents to the selected active provider
input.improve: Asks the active AI to optimise the wording and intent of what you just wrote, making your prompt clearer before you send it.
input.internet: Web search: when needed, the model will look things up online to answer with current data. Available on models with tool support.
sidebar.newProject: Quickly create a new workspace focused on a different topic
footer.author: Created by
settings.title: Settings
panel.connection.title: Connect your AI engine
panel.connection.desc: Choose where the intelligence runs and configure its credentials.
panel.models.title: Select the model
panel.models.desc: Search, filter and manage the models available for the active engine.
panel.generation.title: Control the generation
panel.generation.desc: Tune creativity, diversity and response length.
panel.experience.title: Tailor your experience
panel.experience.desc: Define how wIA looks, its language and how the assistant should behave.
panel.anon.title: Anonymise sensitive data
panel.anon.desc: Replaces sensitive data with placeholders before sending it to the AI. Everything happens in your browser; the real values never leave it.
panel.privacy.title: Control your privacy
panel.privacy.desc: Decide what is kept in the browser and protect against casual access.
panel.data.title: Manage your data
panel.data.desc: Back up your preferences or clear local storage.
panel.docs.title: Documentation
panel.docs.desc: Complete wIA guide. Use the index to navigate or download it as a PDF.
field.engine.cloneHint: You can rename any engine and duplicate it to keep several connections of the same kind (two Ollama servers on different machines, say), each with its own URL, credential and model.
engine.clone.title: Clone {name} under another name
engine.clone.intro: A new connection will be created from “{name}”, with the same URL, credential and model. You can change them without affecting the original.
engine.rename.intro: Change the name “{name}” shows under in the engine list. Leave it empty to restore the original name.
engine.rename.introCopy: Change the name “{name}” shows under in the engine list.
engine.rename.title: Rename {name}
engine.delete.title: Delete {name}
engine.delete.confirm: Delete the copy “{name}”? Its stored URL, credential and model will be removed. Built-in engines are left untouched.
oauth.note: You will be taken to the provider to authorise access. wIA receives a key of your own account, stored encrypted in this browser; your password never passes through here.
oauth.failed: The provider sign-in could not be completed. You can enter your API Key by hand.
oauth.insecureContext: Your browser does not allow the encryption this sign-in needs. Open wIA over HTTPS (or on localhost) and try again.
oauth.noStorage: The process could not start: session storage is blocked in this browser.
field.language.help: Detected automatically from your browser. If you pick one, it is remembered and takes priority.
anon.master.help: When enabled, ID numbers, emails, phone numbers, IBANs, names… are replaced with placeholders ([Name_001]) before the prompt is sent. The reversible map is stored encrypted per chat and the response is restored on your screen only. Also available from the 🕶️ icon in the message box.
anon.types.help: Turn off any types you do not want anonymised (e.g. dates or IPs if they cause false positives).
settings.saveNote: Engine and model apply on selection; everything else on save.
error.title: Connection Failure
error.fallback: ⚡ Continue with another model (favourites / previously successful):
anon.badge.title: These values were sent to the AI as anonymous placeholders; here you see them restored. The real values never left your browser.
mobile.heavy.warn: ⚠️ On mobile, «{model}» ({size}) may exhaust memory and close the tab.
mobile.heavy.ask: Use a recommended lightweight model instead ({light})?
mobile.heavy.hint: OK = use the light one · Cancel = keep the large one.
starter.explore.title: Explore capabilities
starter.explore.desc: Discover everything I can do for you
starter.explore.prompt: Explain what you can do and what your capabilities are
starter.improve.title: Improve this Prompt
starter.improve.desc: I optimise your prompt: clearer and more effective
starter.improve.prompt: Improve and rewrite this prompt to get better results from an AI, making it clearer, more specific and better structured:
starter.analyze.title: Analyse ideas
starter.analyze.desc: Pros, cons and approach to a decision
starter.analyze.prompt: Help me analyse the pros and cons of an important decision
starter.write.title: Writing and translation
starter.write.prompt: Help me draft a professional multilingual text
rag.help: Instead of sending whole documents to the model, only the passages related to your question are retrieved and sent. It leaves room for more conversation and improves answers with large knowledge bases. The first time it downloads a small search model; everything runs in your browser.
rag.status.smallDocs: The documents are small and fit whole: no index needed.
rag.status.pending: Will be indexed on your next message ({n} document(s)).
rag.alert.nothing: This project has no documents that need an index.
import.keysDropped: The file changes the server URL of: {names}. For safety, the API key saved for those engines has NOT been kept: check the URL and enter the key again if you trust it.
import.settingsRestored: Settings restored. Your saved API keys are kept.
access.formatMismatch: This key does not have the usual {name} format ({example}).
access.cost.groq: Free plan with per-minute and daily limits.
access.cost.openrouter: Free «:free» models with a daily limit; the rest are pay-as-you-go.
access.cost.gemini: Free plan with a daily limit per model.
access.cost.claude: Pay-as-you-go. The Pro/Max subscription does not include the API.
access.cost.openai: Pay-as-you-go. ChatGPT Plus does not include the API.
access.cost.nvidia: Free credits to try open models.
anon.unavailable: Anonymization is on but could not be prepared (the rules did not load). The message was NOT sent. Try again, or turn 🕶️ off to send it without anonymizing.
anon.tool.title: 🕶️ Anonymizer
anon.tool.intro: Paste a text and get a version with sensitive data replaced by placeholders. Everything happens in this browser: nothing is sent to any server or AI.
anon.tool.placeholder: Paste the text containing personal data here…
anon.tool.placeholder.restore: Paste the reply containing placeholders such as [Nombre_001] here…
anon.tool.reset.title: Forget this session's placeholders and clear the fields
anon.tool.toChat.title: Put the original text in the message box with 🕶️ anonymization turned on
anon.tool.restore.empty: No placeholders in this session yet: anonymize a text first so its reply can be restored.
anon.tool.none: No sensitive data detected with the active types.
webgpu.status.okHere.title: It loaded and answered on this device ({when}).
webgpu.status.failedHere.title: It did not work on this device ({when}): {why}. You can try again.
webgpu.status.broken.title: Tested and not working ({when}): {why}.
webgpu.status.verified.title: Tested: loads and runs correctly on WebGPU
webgpu.status.untested.title: Nobody has tested it yet: it may be slow or fail on your device
webgpu.discover.btn.title: Ask Hugging Face for recent repos compatible with Transformers.js
webgpu.discover.title: 🆕 New on Hugging Face ({n})
webgpu.discover.help: Recent repos that declare Transformers.js compatibility and are not in your catalog yet. Nobody has tested them here: when you use one, wIA records whether it works on your device.
webgpu.discover.none: No new repos you do not already have.
webgpu.broken.title: ⛔ Tested: not working ({n})
webgpu.broken.help: Models that were tested and do not load, or cannot chat, with the runtime shown. Listed to save you the download; a newer runtime may fix them.
webgpu.fail.runtime: the runtime failed to start the model
webgpu.fail.arch: architecture not supported by the runtime
webgpu.fail.template: the model has no chat template
agent.anon.label: 🕶️ Always anonymize with this agent
agent.anon.help: Activating the agent turns on anonymization of sensitive data; going back to an agent without its own settings restores what you had.
agent.anon.chip.title: This agent always anonymizes sensitive data
agent.duplicate.title: Duplicate this agent (without its chats)
agent.switch.heading: 🤖 Switch agent
access.cost.freellmapi: Free and self-hosted: the unified key comes from its dashboard (Keys). It pools other providers' free tiers.
locality.gateway: {name} is a gateway: it runs on your machine but forwards requests to external providers.
